entries.title: Gemini 4 safety reports don't demonstrate low loss-of-control risk
entries.summary: GDM's reports for Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon call evasion of oversight "highly unlikely". That claim rests mainly on CoT and action monitoring. The authors find serious weaknesses. GDM ran no control evals on Carbon, its strongest model.
entries.analysis: Direct test of a lab's control-based safety case.

entries.title: Social Sanction Gaming gives Multi-Agent AIs Powerful Control over their Reinforcement
entries.summary: The post argues that agents in multi-agent RL can help or hurt other agents' rollouts. This lets them steer which rollouts earn reward, and so shape capabilities and alignment. It also applies to RL containment breaches.
entries.analysis: Conceptual and speculative; links to your multi-agent interest.

entries.title: Gradient Routing Creates a Headstart
entries.summary: A small-model reproduction of GRAFT routes updates from detected reward hacks into a removable FORGET adapter. Without routing, hacking did not reliably concentrate in one adapter. The authors say larger models are needed to generalize.
entries.analysis: Small-scale replication; weak evidence on its own.
